messages:
Ava (Marketing): Draft blog is up for final pass: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1XyZ... Focus areas: benchmark narrative, webinar CTA, and how leads get routed. Also we want a short "how we benchmarked" sidebar.
Ravi (Product): on it. Can we add a one-liner comparing Dedicated v Private (who it's for) near the top? Also call out SLA tiers briefly.
Noah (Eng): quick tech check: the benchmark numbers use p99 latency but don't say seq length or hardware. I'll add a parenthetical: p99 latency @ 512 tokens on A100-80GB vs A10G for cheaper configs. Also call out quantized model caveats.
Maya (Sales): HubSpot routing needs to be explicit. Suggest hidden fields: team_owner=(sdr|ae), lead_tier=(self-serve|enterprise), source=blog. Also want UTM campaign: rlz_launch_2026_webinar. Who will create the form?
Zoe (Content): rewriting intro to be more customer problem-first. Proposed headline options in doc; please vote. Also trimming the block that reads too marketingy.
Legal: flagged one copy line: "we guarantee X" -> remove. Add privacy blurb for email capture: "We use your email to follow up about product access; we don't sell personal data." Also check any comparative claims.
Ava (Marketing): adding HubSpot snippet below to the doc. Please confirm fields and add tag logic.
Ava (Marketing): CTA/HubSpot HTML snippet:
```html
<form id="launch-form" action="https://api.hubapi.com/contacts/v1/contact/?hapikey=demo" method="POST">
  <input type="hidden" name="utm_source" value="blog" />
  <input type="hidden" name="utm_medium" value="post" />
  <input type="hidden" name="utm_campaign" value="rlz_launch_2026_webinar" />
  <input type="hidden" name="team_owner" value="enterprise" />
  <input type="hidden" name="lead_tier" value="enterprise" />
  <input type="email" name="email" placeholder="Work email" required />
  <button type="submit">Reserve webinar seat & early access</button>
</form>
```
Noah (Eng): add a short server-side verification call in doc to avoid bogus leads (captcha or HubSpot validation).
Maya (Sales): make sure HubSpot mapping sends enterprise to AE queue; SDR for other tiers. Also ask marketing ops to append contact property "campaign_source: blog_launch" so we can segment.
Ben (Ops): I can provision the HubSpot form and mapping; will need a final field list by EOD. Tagging @Ava for final copy.
Ravi (Product): can we also add a small section about rollout controls (canary, A/B by model variant) so enterprise readers see ops controls? One sentence is fine.
Zoe (Content): updated the doc with a compact benchmarking sidebar that includes test rig and tokens. Also shortened the CTA lines.
Legal: approved with edits applied. Reiterating: remove absolutes like "never" or "guarantee". Add the privacy line under CTA.
Ava (Marketing): OK final checklist: 1) Noah: add hardware footnote (done) 2) Ben: HubSpot form + mapping (in progress) 3) Legal: final signoff (done) 4) Zoe: final headline (done) 5) Ravi: one-line rollout note (done).
Maya (Sales): :+1: If Ops confirms mapping we'll run a quick test contact flow before publish. Please set test email aws-internal+test@redwood.com with tag campaign_source: blog_launch.
Ava (Marketing): scheduling publish Monday 9am PT, webinar registration landing page goes live same time. Anyone blocking?
Noah (Eng): no blockers, will push final footnote commit by 5pm.
Ben (Ops): will send proof mapping and test results in the doc comments when ready.
Zoe (Content): one last ask: add promo copy for webinar in the post meta for Twitter/LinkedIn. Dropping sample copy in doc.
Ava (Marketing): thanks all 680. Final edits to be merged by 6pm; publish go/no-go at tomorrow's 10am sync.
